# Dependency map (generated — do not edit)

> Generated by `cargo xtask dep-map --write` from module headers and computed facts (docs/architecture/maintainability.md). `--check` fails on any hand edit. Layout (ADR-0051, T-CI-3): no aggregate counts (`dep-map --check` prints them) and one `- item` line per list element, so two changes that touch different items merge without conflict.

## Processes

Per module, one line per element: `reads` / `writes` / `executes` = the tables and functions of its `PostgreSQL` declaration, `env` = environment variables, `service` = declared services. An empty list has no line.
